title: Stress-lane sprint library: scenario-driven quarterly roadmap for Hosted API & Model Fleet
creator: Nina Mercado
description: Design and pilot a quarterly planning pattern that groups roadmap work into explicit 'stress lanes' (Surge, Regression, Security, Capacity). Each lane defines a set of signals, reserved commit windows, and cross-team runbooks so hosted API feature changes and model catalog updates can be prioritized and executed with predictable risk exposure. This initiative ties to OKR A.2 (Reduce regression rate) and OKR B.1 (Stable latency under surge).
acceptance_criteria: Four stress lanes (Surge, Regression, Security, Capacity) are documented with primary signals and ownership
Mapping spreadsheet that links all hosted-api and model-catalog initiatives to a lane and matching OKR
Commit window calendar for the quarter with automated gating rules and fallback policies
Playbook for lane-triggered fast-track and rollback, reviewed by Eng, SRE, and Support
Dashboard that surfaces lane health metrics and trigger events (traffic, error budget, model-quality regressions)
tasks: Draft stress-lane taxonomy and signal definitions — owner: Omar — doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pm/stress-lanes-draft
Inventory hosted-api/model-catalog planned changes and assign lanes — owner: PM triage — sheet: https://drive.google.com/hosted-inv
Design commit window gating (canary % thresholds, perf/regression checks) — owner: ENG-Runtime — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/2841
Build lane-health dashboard prototype — owner: Analytics — grafana: grafana.redwood.ai/d/hl/stress-lanes
Tabletop run of surge and regression scenarios with SRE and Support — owner: Ops — schedule: 2026-03-22
notes: Trade-offs: more upfront planning reduces mid-quarter churn but increases coordination overhead
We will reserve 15% of commit capacity each week as an operational hedge for surge lane fixes
Consider integrating model-eval automated checks to the gating pipeline to reduce manual sign-off
Stakeholders: Runtime, Dedicated, Private, Support, Solutions Eng — weekly sync recommended
